text: Hey, Lukas. Got a minute? I was at the counter just now and heard your little story about the guy who missed an empty net from three meters. Was that supposed to be me?
What? No, that wasn’t about you. It was a video I saw online, that’s all. Don’t take it so personally.

Oh, okay. Sorry, I just... I guess it sounded really familiar, you know? And everyone laughed, so I thought maybe you were making fun of me. If it wasn’t about me, then I’m glad to hear that. I just felt a bit awkward.
Yeah, I get that. I didn’t even think about the match, honestly. It was just something funny I saw earlier this week. If it came across the wrong way, that wasn’t my intention.
Alright, fair enough. I guess I was just a bit sensitive after Sunday. It’s still kind of stuck in my head. I appreciate you saying it wasn’t meant that way. No hard feelings from me.
Thanks, Daniel. I can see why it would get to you. That kind of thing happens to everyone at some point. If you want to talk about the match or anything, I’m here.

Thanks, Lukas, that actually means a lot. I know it happens, but it’s still tough to shake off. I keep replaying that moment in my head. How did you see the rest of the match? Did we play as badly as it felt, or was it just one of those days?

Honestly, I thought we played alright for most of it. We had some good chances and kept the pressure up. That last bit just didn’t go our way, but it wasn’t all bad. I wouldn’t beat yourself up over one moment.
